angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,050,507 km at 245.65 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 4.0708 +/- 0.0149 mas (same row, RUWE 1.14): 245.65 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.51 +/- 0.04 solar radii from Gressier et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-79 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...672A..34G/abstract): 1,050,507 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.39 +/- 0.06 solar masses from Gressier et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-79 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...672A..34G/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6600 +/- 100 K from Gressier et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-79 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...672A..34G/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Gressier et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-79 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...672A..34G/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-79.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.223, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-79 (pscomppars): spectral type F5, from Gressier et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...672A..34G/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-79 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.03 dex, from Gressier et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...672A..34G/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-79 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.66447, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-79 (pscomppars): age 1.4 Gyr, from Brown et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017MNRAS.464..810B/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-79 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 19.1 km/s, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
